purpose: Test whether a shared ECG Shape Recovery head and explicit ECG Anchor Estimation head coexist without morphology regression, and whether structured anchor decoding removes independent-head ordering failures.
dataset: MMECG loso_v2 folds 2/6/10, unused by the topology design decision

arms.A0: shared WSST stem/TCN + 200-point ECG Shape Recovery head + incumbent two-scale R-anchor head
arms.A1: same shared representation and shape head + independent Q/R/S/T anchor logits
arms.A2: the frozen A1 network with a preregistered R-centred physiological structured decoder; no retraining and no test-derived thresholds

single_changed_variable: ECG Anchor Estimation read-out: two-scale R control versus independent Q/R/S/T versus structured decoding of the same Q/R/S/T logits.
capacity_control: A0 and A1 instantiate the same four-logit anchor projection and have exactly identical parameter counts; A0 scores and optimizes only its first two R-scale logits.
shape_target: Reference-ECG central R-to-R cardiac cycle nearest the 8-second window centre, resampled to 200 points and independently min-max normalised; oracle-defined morphology task, explicitly not blind continuous reconstruction.
loss: Shape L1 + 0.5*(1-PCC) + 0.3*anchor BCE. A0 uses narrow/wide R Gaussian targets (sigma 4/16 samples); A1 uses Q/R/S/T Gaussian targets (sigma 4). Weights are fixed for all folds.
checkpoint_selection: Validation-only lexicographic selection: highest shape PCC, then lowest shape RMSE, then highest anchor detection score. Test is loaded once after checkpoint freeze.

promotion_gate.shape_noninferiority: A1 shape PCC is no more than 0.02 below A0 on every fold and fold-macro RMSE does not worsen by more than 0.01.
promotion_gate.anchor_accuracy: A2 improves at least 3/4 median Q/R/S/T MedAEs versus the frozen Chen-TCN comparator and reduces unweighted macro MedAE by at least 10%.
promotion_gate.ordering: A2 complete-beat Q<R<S<T violation rate is <=0.01 on every fold.
promotion_gate.coverage: For every promoted fiducial, A2 matched-event coverage is no more than 0.03 below Chen-TCN.
promotion_gate.decision: All clauses pass: authorize the final dual-head REM-Net seed-42 11-fold run. Any clause fails: do not expand.

constraints: No continuous waveform decoder, native RCG, calibration, delay warp, threshold sweep or test-derived physiology range.
Folds 1/5/9 are not reused for this confirmation gate.
A2 is a deterministic read-out of A1 probabilities and therefore does not create a third training run.

A2 uses the R logit peaks as anchors, Q=max in 5--100 ms before R, S=max in 5--100 ms after R, and T=max from 40 ms after S to min(450 ms after S, the next R); these ranges are frozen before test access.
